createdFor: Independent browser equivalents: original implementations, approximate visual coverage, not a native shell conversion
conditionalCoverage: All equivalents remain local demonstrations; no OS backend or literal shader pipeline.
Nine CRT visual studies approximate the reference techniques, not pixel-identical Slang feedback.

additionalOriginalEffects.note: No matching visual source family found; original additional effect, do not label a port.

all30Families.webScope: Reusable page-owned chamfered translucent panels, CSS perspective, glow and sliced/text reveals.
Demonstration meters with supplied values; no OS sensor data.
Original fictional map/radar, compass, weather and network card using sample/provider data; no automatic geolocation or native network state.
In-page launch/focus/status buttons, badges and local audio animation; no native application execution.
Search/filter/keyboard-activate page items with quickhack-like focus and glitch states; no installed-app enumeration.
Page event queue/history/detail and corruption-dismissal; no reading OS notification or tray data.
Local switches/sliders/tabs/device-row examples and settings previews; no OS controls, credentials or global hotkey changes.
Needs explicit local HUD layout subview: visibility, scale, anchor and X/Y per widget; Minimal/Balanced/Cinematic/Custom presets. CSS preview and localStorage only.
Original CSS-token theme variations inspired by eight source palette categories; original/system fonts and original icon substitutes.
Original market/news terminal with sparkline/chart, searchable/filterable feed and detail panels. Bundled samples; optional provider CORS API. No financial execution.
Owned page audio/metadata/transport and now-playing banner; no arbitrary system MPRIS access.
Local update/progress/achievement/volume/brightness presentation demos. No package upgrades or OS mixer/brightness control.
Animate owned scene/section snapshots or layers; no Hyprland workspace switching or silent desktop capture.
Independent visual recreation of RGB split, tears, streaks/noise and scanline layers on owned content. Root shader is not linked in observed runtime.
Local rectangular selection plus coordinates, targeting, shutter/banner, REC camera frame/timecode and start/stop transition. Real getDisplayMedia/MediaRecorder optional and permission-based.
Distinct original in-page pointer-following rotating scanner/emblem, line-drawn targeting HUD, radial vignette and glitch alert/banner. Dismisses demo only; never kills processes.
Fictional auth-state demo with image/video fallback, scanlines, clock/ticker, focus/caret, panel rise/fade and failed-state shake; never OS login, PAM or session lock.
Slide/fade/blur owned browser panels and sections only.
Netrunner-style red terminal raster/bloom/jitter/RGB/caret preset independently implemented; no shell execution.
Distinct local timed boot-log rows and module block-progress then owned-content reveal. No external CyberSpace site or copied log strings.
Scoped browser button/menu/focus/selection/tooltip/scrollbar styling, not whole-desktop GTK/Qt/terminal theming.

noLicenseLimits.sourceCode: Most project QML/TS/CSS/custom shader sources have no license grant; recreate concepts independently, do not copy code/assets
noLicenseLimits.embeddedException: 27 accumulate.slang/blur_horiz.slang/blur_vert.slang copies have Mattias Gustavsson 2016 MIT OR public-domain/Unlicense text; preserve license if reusing these isolated files
noLicenseLimits.assets: No blanket license for bundled game motifs, fonts, icons, audio, wallpapers or images; use original replacements
noLicenseLimits.readme: Explicitly describes recreating Cyberpunk 2077 UI; credits include cool-retro-term

webPlatformLimits.scope: Browser effects operate within page bounds and its own DOM/Canvas; cannot decorate/control arbitrary OS windows
webPlatformLimits.native: No PAM/SDDM/Wayland lock, Hyprland workspace/window control, arbitrary process launch/kill, package install/update, D-Bus tray/notifications, pactl/wpctl mixers, bluetoothctl/nmcli, brightnessctl, native global hotkeys or /proc/hw telemetry from an ordinary browser page
webPlatformLimits.capture: getDisplayMedia requires secure context and user selection/gesture; MediaRecorder support differs; cannot silently capture desktop or simulate an OS lock
webPlatformLimits.media: Only page-owned media via HTML media/WebAudio/MediaSession; cannot read arbitrary system MPRIS sessions
webPlatformLimits.notifications: In-page demos work; OS web notifications require permission and differ from native notification history
webPlatformLimits.data: RSS/market/weather/map endpoints need CORS, keys/rate-limit handling, attribution or a trusted backend; bundle sample data as fallback
webPlatformLimits.accessibility: Provide reduced-motion mode, keyboard/focus, pause/stop effects, mute-by-default audio; avoid automatic high-intensity flashes

coverageClaim: 30 source families mapped to 24 original browser component demos and nine CRT variants. File coverage describes provenance, not complete native functionality or pixel parity.
verificationBoundary: All24demos load and interactions/viewport/reduced/fallback paths exercised locally. Source-family coverage is approximate and does not certify every native behavior or pixel fidelity.
